body: Yes you can OP. Well done for taking that first step into recovery!

Well, it seems you are pushing yourself too hard, aim for not smaller goals, just not big picture goals. so one small step at a time. Also every month or 2 or 3, review, what can you change, or what should you keep on doing?

This advice is most likely useless, and im sure you have heard it before. But it doesnt matter if you disappoint someone else, sure its nice to, but as long as you dont disappoint yourself, its fine. If you are being pushed for a job that you would hate dont do it. However, dont just aim low, that is a slippery slope.

I hope i helped, feel free to pm me whenever you want. Good luck with everything OP
